name: Financier Le Poidevin

intro.text: I work in finance. Don't ask what I do, I'd have to charge you. The islands do very nicely on trust, funds and good lawyers.

win: Dear me. A loss. I'll write that off against something.
after: Jersey sets its own taxes and has done for centuries. We're not part of the UK and not part of the EU, but we're awfully good at paperwork.
